text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. Passing by the gym,
I saw Espoir City holding a basketball.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Take careful aim... Take THISSS!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—...Gwaaaahhh!!
Dammit, missed again!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? You can tell just by looking. It's free throws, free throws.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"We've got an inter-team free-throw contest coming up in class.
So that's why I'm doing some special training with these guys."

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
But the other teams look pretty tough, so~...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, that was amazing!!
Nice shot!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi has a pro basketball team, after all.
As an Umamusume representing Funabashi,
I can't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"What extraordinary spirit...! I must devote myself
to my training as well, so I don't fall behind
Furioso-san."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So that's the trick to shooting. I see, I see~
Concise and hits all the key points.
Kris S-chan, you're pretty good at teaching, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks. You're also... a fast learner, Tran.
Also, that gadget—you recommended...
It's been really—helpful—for checking my form."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Bwahahaha! Looks like the Three Musketeers have assembled!
Then let us go forth together and claim the blessing of the Goddess of Victory!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. Who cares about the others?
We're gonna do our own thing—

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. Practicing is probably pointless anyway, so let's just wing it.

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know my own limits.
No need to get all worked up over it, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. Why don't you guys just do whatever you want then?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't quitting. I'll train until I hit the mark every single time
and win the championship all on my own."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "Losing to yourself is the lamest thing you could ever do, after all."

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text: Huh? What...? Espo-san?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school—passing by the gymnasium once again,
I found Espoir City's teammates
peeking inside.
choice_data_list: Hey, what are you looking at?
Hey, what are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard Espo-san was still practicing.
So I thought I'd come take a quick peek...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...――Tch, again?
Seriously, am I just clumsy or what...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... but still!
No way in hell am I going out looking like a loser...!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Next time for sure, I'm gonna slam it right in!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!! ...—Hell yeah!!
Did you see that, punks?!!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...
Espo-san was struggling so much at first...

text_block_list.name: Teammate B
text_block_list.text:
...It's kind of embarrassing, isn't it...?
Acting all cool, talking about 'my limits' and all.
choice_data_list: Won't you still make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text: Espo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! ...What is it with you guys?

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
"It might be late to jump in, but... we're doing it too!
We hate staying uncool, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Whatever, do as you like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the days of intense special training for Espoir City and the others continued—until the day of the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text:
—Espo-san, do your best~~!!
—We're leaving the rest to you, Espo-san!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! I'd have rammed it in
even without you asking.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*Inhaaaale*... *pheeew*...
......—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —ORAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, amazing! First place~~!
You practiced every single day after all.
If it were me, I think I would've melted!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Seizing victory through a dramatic comeback—was that the Night Battle of Kawagoe, or perhaps Okehazama?
Though you were our foe, it was truly magnificent~!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhhh!!
I took the top spot, hell yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Yay!!
You were amazing, Espo-san! That totally blew me away!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?!
You guys did awesome too, hey!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Wait, what's with that smirk?!
Y-You think I was getting carried away or something?!
Well, you're wrong, alright?!"
choice_data_list: It's thanks to you firing everyone up.
It's all thanks to you firing everyone up

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Wait, what's with that smirk?!
Y-You think I was getting carried away or something?!
Well, you're wrong, alright?!"
choice_data_list: It's thanks to you firing everyone up.
It's all thanks to you firing everyone up

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't go saying I got them fired up...
They just jumped on the bandwagon on their own.

text_block_list.name: Teammate A
text_block_list.text:
Still... I was only able to work this hard
because of you, Espo-san! Really, thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your thanks. You're the ones
who worked hard... Jeez.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, obviously!
Plus, I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see more? Then I'll show ya!
I'll prove to ya that I don't have any limits!
